text: 各位投資先進大家好，我是摩根士丹利台灣醫藥健康分析師 Jack Lin。今天的說明會將以英文及中文雙語進行。管理層將與各位分享第三季度營運表現以及未來業務展望。問答環節將以中英文雙語進行。Good afternoon everyone. Thank you for joining today's Bora Pharmaceuticals third quarter 2026 earnings call. This is Jack Lin, China Biotech and Taiwan Healthcare Analyst at Morgan Stanley. Today's call will be conducted in both English and Mandarin, with management walking us through the third quarter results this year and business outlook, followed by a Q-and-A session in both languages.

So 我們可以看到這一季我們的獲利成長性，本季是賺一季勝一季，延續第二季的動能。季營收季增新台幣 5.64 億，營業利益季增新台幣 1.04 億。CDMO 事業規模逐漸擴大，CDMO 自製產能季增 16%，為 2025 年以來季度對季度最大的增幅。營收新台幣 20.85 億，年增 16.9%，季減 1.5%。
全球銷售業務加速成長，三季營收新台幣 33.02 億元，年增 9.3%，季增 12.5%。受惠於罕病產品線表現優於管理層預期，以及 GLS 業務表現。2027 年起中期能見度為歷年來最高，未來 12 個月在手訂單達 3.4 億美元，北美各場能見度充足。
在我們重要的里程碑可以看到分四個項目。一個是 CDMO 新接的訂單，新接的訂單奠定中期商業化的基礎。今年累積新簽案量金額達到 4.36 億美元，主要來自於年中時公告的大藥廠多年期商業化合約，以及持續深化的研發合作專案組合。
研發合作與前 20 大藥廠簽訂多年期約，有關技術以及移轉持續進行中，並分階段投入資本支出以及資源整合。那在馬里蘭針劑廠部分，我們的產能準備，馬里蘭針劑廠、Isolator 的隔離器技術轉換順利進行中。新的 Isolator 產能已完成 4 批的製程驗證，預計在 Q4、第四季向技術移轉，預計在 2027 年進行。
那全球銷售部分，季增雙位數，全球銷售業務為集團之主。營收季增 19.3%，年增 12.5%。專科品牌藥較 2025 年年底平均水準成長 14%。受惠於罕病藥點滴的持續逐季成長，提高品牌藥獲利貢獻。
罕病藥點滴受惠於罕病藥點滴的持續逐季成長，提高品牌藥獲利貢獻。GLS 及主力學名藥維持市場的領導地位。在我們今年進行的兩個併購案也非常成功，包含太福與威德，完整貢獻季度，集團綜效計畫啟動。太福常駐製劑併入保瑞，鎖定及加強 API 的量產訂單。威德 Global Nutrition 併入保瑞，未來首個季度為晨暉帶來顯著營收。
那接下來看到財報的部分。我們的美國市場與全球銷售季、季獲利將隨著稼動率的優化而逐步的擴張。第三季的營收是 4.5 億... 續續續... 第三季營收是 4.5 億，QoQ 成長 9.6%，YoY 成長 34.3%。營業毛利的部分是 25.29 億，QoQ 成長 4.1%，YoY 成長 16.5%。
毛利率 39% 跟預期的 41% 還有空間。那營業利益的部分是 10.09 億，較第二季的 9.87 億增加了 1.04 億。季增 11.5%，年增 20%。
在本期淨利的部分 6.54 億，季增 9.5%，年增 2.9%。EPS 是 4.79 元，季增 9.9%。那年減，因為去年有一次性的利益。所以在 EPS 的部分跟去年拿除一次性的利益還是有成長。
排除兩季度中的一次性或相關費用，營業利益實際季增是 1.4 億新台幣。馬里蘭針劑廠 2026 年受法規變動影響表現不如預期，部分在手訂單會遞延到 2027 年出貨。
晨暉企業太福生技 2026 年損益翻、轉型的相關措施，包括剩餘私藥、設備部分的減損。那我們目前非常 focus 在未來的成長動能，兩個關鍵的專案是完成馬里蘭針劑廠隔離產線轉換，確保批次生產不中斷，逐量交付，重拾營收與獲利動能。整合 Rockville 與 San Diego 廠，共 2 萬公升以上細生物製劑原料產能，以及竹北開發能量，打造單一生物製劑 CDMO 的平台。
那在我們的營收、Q3 的營收組成可以看到全球銷售部分，佔整個營收的 51%。47% 來自於專科與品牌藥 Specialty Pharma 的部分。4% 全球學名藥。第二大是 CDMO，CDMO 佔整體營收的 33%。這不含內部的訂單。67% 是非無菌製劑，14% 是無菌製劑。生物製劑部分來到 9%，這也是未來相當大的成長動能。
那在 CHC 的部分佔整體營收 16%。77% 來自於威德品牌的銷售，16% 來自於台灣的業務，7% 來自原料與 CDMO。威德業務最大宗為健康長壽運動增效的兩類產品。可以看到，我們今年雖然做了兩個蠻大的併購案，就是威德的併購以及太福的生物製劑廠。

併購完成後我們仍然有相當充裕的現金，有 55 億新台幣跟現金等價物。因為 84 億是準備在 7 月份交割太福的。所以營運資金還是非常的充足。那因為這兩個併購案，Leverage Buyout 負債比的部分 Net Debt to Equity 有稍微的增加，從 1.2 到 1.3。那我們在做整個帳債的規劃當中。那在營收對、營收從 2024 年第四季的 53.14% 逐漸下降到 33.36%。CDMO 降到 28.14%，第三季降到 18.48%。全球銷售業務落實首度逐季成長，第三季佔 51%，並調整高度獲利之專科與學名藥。那保瑞集團在國際流動性波動趨勢下，併購策略良好。那未來的現金流的需求，接下來我們就請我們的 CEO Bobby 來跟大家介紹整個 Business Update。Bobby, please.

For the CDMO, we've still, some of the highlights, we still continue to see strong growth in sales and new molecules.

In the last two years of acquisitions, we've invested 55 million in capital, especially for our North America facilities, and it's allowed us to focus on specialized capabilities for each of the sites, especially for our Maple Grove facility that is focused on controlled substance and also the expansion of our biologics capability in Rockville, Maryland. Our new signings are very exciting, are expected to bring 24 new molecules into Bora network as of Q3, including three NCEs, spanning from clinical trial all the way to registration, adding to the 110 molecules within the Bora manufacturing process this quarter.

12-month rolling backlog stayed firm at 340 million till the end of Q3 2026, reflecting the timing of the conversion of the Maryland injectable facility as we are getting ramping that back up and into the isolator lines, which I'll talk about a little later. YTD CDMO wins have reached a new high as we stated, actually had a new high since last quarter. We continue to drive new sales into the sites and into the business, especially with our multi-year commercial agreements in our largest facility in North America, and that is the Maple Grove facility.

We have clear visibility from the 12-month backlog into actually a recurring five-year commercial supply for a lot of our sites. Highlight to our CDMO business is our Rockville acquisition, as Alice explained in our financials, we in Q3, we spent a large sum of money to acquire the Rockville facility. Now that facility is integral into for us being a end-to-end all-in-one global pharmaceutical CDMO and to get to the biologics..

biologics CDMO side of the business to scale. Right now we see a 12-month rolling backlog of 50 million US dollars already into that facility alone. The eight batches we've produced in Q3 alone is very, very close and will exceed for the rest of the year the 13 that was produced in 2025. So it's an impressive quarter for the facility and a great start for the facility as well.

We're expecting to realize and continue to realize a lot of the synergies that we have with that facility and the Tanvex facility in San Diego and the Bora Biologics Zunyi facility in Taiwan. We're one of the few facilities that has an end-to-end from cell line development all the way to commercial product drug substance and to drug product in our fill and finish facility in Baltimore.

So that's really and a majority of that happens within North America. So that's really producing a lot of demand and a lot of inquiries for manufacturing within North America and a biologic facility that does an end-to-end all within North America. We also have our first year of revenues and earnings for that facility and if you take out one-time expenses, we are already cash flow positive in that facility. So some really good milestones for the biologics acquisition that we've just acquired.

Okay, and then in the outlook for 2027, I split our sites into the more mature sites and our high growth facilities. Our scaled-up mature facilities we continue to see actually a lot of benefit from once we get to scale, we actually start specializing them in their particular niches, especially now like the Canadian facility is focused more on semi-solids and liquids.

And our Zunyi facility is really benefiting from its high potency and hormone manufacturing capabilities. And we'll continue to do that and rationalize the products that are in those facilities and increase the gross margin in those facilities as well. We also have intensified our marketing efforts and sales efforts for this onshore tailwind that we have. US CDMO business is positioned very well to capture domestic commercial demand and orders.

And we continue to see momentum in our mature facilities in Canada and Zunyi as well. As for the future, the Maple Grove still continues to grow. We still continue to see large pharma and innovative small pharma fill that facility. We are continuing the contract that we signed in Q2 and onboarding that company and those products into the facility, which we will see start to mature and start to show sizable revenues in the end of 2027 and into 28.

The Bora Biologics network, of course, that we just explained before is realizing a lot of the synergies because of our three sites and our fill and finish capabilities right down the street from Rockville in Baltimore. Finally, the Maryland injectable facility, we are seeing strong 12-month backlog. That backlog is especially being built up as we are transferring a lot of our clients from the RABS technology into the isolator technology.
Which is taking about a quarter or two and will boost margins and boost productivity as we get products and customers into the isolator lines and also into a more compliance with the FDA.

A little bit of insight onto the type of capex we're investing into our facilities. Like I was saying before, as our sites, some of our sites get to scalability, we're continuing to invest in differentiating our capabilities. For example, our oral solid dose, we are focusing more on controlled substance and the controlled substance management and safety of the controlled substance sites. Also high potency, hormone as well as oncology-related high potency type products.

On the non-sterile liquids, we're focusing like oral nano-suspension, nebulizer technology, sterile fill and finish, obviously the big move into isolator-enabled technology per a lot of guidance with the FDA and the trends. We are leading that trend and we are going above and beyond what the FDA is asking for and we are all-in on the isolator technology, especially liquids and lyophilization vials, pre-filled syringe.

Of course, we want to really focus on the small to mid-volume as the capabilities of biologics and the titer and the yield rates go up. We realize that the small to mid-volume range is a great range to be in and we're doing very well as we can see with our backlog. Obviously focusing more on semi-solids with our scalability in our Canadian facility and finally once again rounding out our capabilities in biologics and really leaning into getting to scale and getting to a sizable amount of representation of biologics into our facility.

So going from a non-sterile environment all the way to a full sterile biologics facility, that really is increasing our capabilities and increasing our presence into the CDMO landscape and becoming a real important player and partner in the CDMO space. Next page.

A little bit of insight into our pharma sales business. Our pharma sales business has seen exceptional, exceptional growth quarter over quarter in the last 18 months as you guys can probably see. It is, as Alice our CFO showed in one of the slides, it has outpaced our CDMO growth of the business with really great management, really great products and seeing sustainable manufacturing capabilities and sustainable supply because of our strong CDMO presence.

That synergy is really coming to fruition as you can see our revenues is increased quarter over quarter and year over year arriving at 3.3 billion in Q3 alone. And it's the first quarter that both quarter over quarter and Y-o-Y have seen growth since 2025. So that is definitely getting back on track after our product rationalization we did towards the end of last year and we definitely see that trending up.

As you can see in the first half of 2026, we highlighted that our specialty pharma business was exceeding our generic business, but generic business has rebounded strong with our strong defense of our key products, our key high margin products. And so that has started to come back in a very strong way. But we're seeing both growth in specialty and high-value generics.

A little bit of insight into our lead product Vigafied. We continue to see revenue growth. In nine months, our 2026 revenues has already exceeded and matched our 2025 fiscal year, the whole year. Q3 represents our seventh straight quarter over quarter growth for the Vigafied franchise. And that is a really strong franchise that we still continue to see growth in not only in this quarter but also the following quarters.
And we continue to defend and also maximize our high margin generic products. And obviously as I stated before, we are seeing stabilization and regrowth in that generic space.

And a little bit of insight into our Sunway Biotech business. As you know, that originally was a spin-off of our legacy business in consumer health and some in-licensing, merging that in with Sunway. Sunway's recently acquired Weider Global. We reinvested into Sunway Biotech and now we represent 42% of Sunway. And the acquisition of Weider Global now has really catapulted that company and that brand into being an important part.

As you can see now it's within the next 17% of our revenues and that has become an important part of the Bora Group. And so we want to give you a little insight on the exciting things that are happening with that division and how they're growing that division with Weider Global Health. Now the consumer healthcare division focuses on longevity with nutrition with direct-to-consumer expansion in Europe and also in the United States.

It'll be really that Weider brand is now becoming the backbone of that business and becoming a global brand name. We're growing 36% quarter over quarter since the acquisition. Significant brand scale, rapid profits. Net income for the first nine months of 2026 has already reached 22 times last year's net income. So definitely that pace is exciting, that brand is growing.

And we're definitely seeing once again the synergies from Sunway's R&D, Bora's management and lean management and operational efficiency included as a backbone in manufacturing with the global Weider brand name. So once again, the Bora Group is providing an infrastructure of management, manufacturing, R&D capabilities and expanding on these companies that are now becoming much more involved in our total we call the Bora Group revenue base. Next page.

A little sneak peek into our 2027 growth and our potential and our outlook. We really have seen a comeback in sustainability within our CDMO business. We see that site utilization as it trends upwards, we're going to continue to see increases in gross margin. We're continuing to increase utilization especially in our Maple Grove facility. With our specialty pharma business, as you can see that's a quarter over quarter over growth.

We still see continued growth and not just the Vigafied products but all the specialty brands within that business. And also continued sustainability within the generics business. We've made a lot of investments in the last two years in our biologics and now we are starting to see the biologics impact. And as you can see the story is coming together with our investments in the early stage in our cell line development going into our commercial production.

And then having a fill and finish all within the North America network. So we are going to see the synergistic values of that and we're going to see a lot of those returns come within the next couple of years. Finally once again I mentioned the CHC business. We're going to be the first business in Taiwan that has a global brand consumer business based on backed by real science within the Bora network and also strong, strong, strong manufacturing capabilities.

That will give it its uniqueness and specialization within a very crowded field but also a very fast-paced, fast-growing business as the aging population spending power gets much more active and much more powerful within the global ecosystem.
